boundary_rule: Each complete historical input bin and every future DO bin through the target must belong to the same partition. No borrowed history or cross-boundary labels.

partitions.name: train
partitions.permitted_use: Fit model parameters and learned preprocessing only on this period.

partitions.name: validation
partitions.permitted_use: Select model, features, hyperparameters and stopping rule; no final-test selection.

partitions.name: calibration
partitions.permitted_use: Optional frozen-model interval diagnostics after model selection; no point-model tuning or refitting.

partitions.name: test
partitions.permitted_use: One final evaluation after fitting, selection and any diagnostic calibration choices are locked.

statistical_sufficiency: Not established; small dependent within-study pilot, not independent-site or species validation.
test_access_note: Source-wide metadata, quality diagnostics and ranges were inspected before this freeze. No new-model fit, prediction-error selection or calibration has used these targets.
